recognize_zh: 早產新生兒周邊血中出現大量有核紅血球，部分紅母細胞染色質粗塊狀、呈分裂期樣（mitotic figure）排列，背景還有紅血球碎片與多染性紅血球；這是胎兒水腫時骨髓外造血與紅母細胞增多的表現，CMV 病因本身無法由形態判定。
features: Numerous circulating nucleated red cells, from basophilic/polychromatophilic erythroblasts to pyknotic orthochromatic forms
Several large erythroid precursors with coarsely clumped, segmented chromatin suggestive of mitotic figures (main field and insets)
Inset shows a large granulated myeloid cell with purple-red cytoplasmic granules adjacent to an erythroblast
Red cell fragments and irregular crenated forms, with occasional polychromatic macrocytes
No intracellular viral inclusions or organisms are visible
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear from a premature neonate shows marked erythroblastemia, with nucleated red cells at all stages of maturation, including several large precursors with coarsely condensed, segmented chromatin consistent with circulating mitotic erythroblasts. Red cell fragments and polychromasia are present in the background. An immature granulated myeloid cell is seen in an inset. No viral inclusions are identified; peripheral blood morphology cannot establish the infectious etiology. Findings are consistent with the erythroblastemia of hydrops fetalis, with CMV infection requiring confirmation by PCR or culture.

ddx.dx: Alloimmune hemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn
ddx.vs: Morphology is similar with erythroblastemia and polychromasia, but a positive direct antiglobulin test and maternal alloantibody distinguish it from infection-related hydrops.
TAM shows circulating megakaryoblast-like blasts with cytoplasmic blebs and GATA1 mutation rather than mitotic erythroblasts.
Parvovirus causes red cell aplasia with reticulocytopenia and giant pronormoblasts with glassy intranuclear inclusions in the marrow, not florid circulating erythroblasts.
Hb Bart hydrops shows hypochromic microcytic red cells with target cells and nucleated RBCs, confirmed by hemoglobin electrophoresis showing Hb Bart.
